# Veterinary Medical Centers

Veterinary Medical Centers is a locally owned veterinary practice serving dogs and cats in Fort Thomas, Independence, and surrounding Northern Kentucky communities.

## Official Website

- Canonical site: https://nky.vet/
- Contact: https://nky.vet/contact/
- Book appointment: https://nky.vet/book-appointment/
- New patients: https://nky.vet/new-patients/

## Locations

- Fort Thomas: https://nky.vet/locations/vet-in-fort-thomas-ky/
- Independence: https://nky.vet/locations/vet-in-independence-ky/

## Key Services

- Veterinary services hub: https://nky.vet/services/
- Wellness exams: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/wellness-exams/
- Dog and cat vaccinations: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/dog-cat-vaccinations/
- Puppy and kitten care: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/puppy-kitten-care/
- Pet dental care: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/pet-dental-care/
- Sick pet visits: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/sick-pet-visits/
- Veterinary diagnostics: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/veterinary-diagnostics/
- Senior pet care: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/senior-pet-care/
- Parasite prevention: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/parasite-prevention/
- Skin, ear, and allergy care: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/skin-ear-allergy-care/
- Soft tissue surgery: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/soft-tissue-surgery/
- Spay and neuter surgery: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/spay-neuter-surgery/
- Nutrition and weight guidance: https://nky.vet/veterinary-services/nutrition-weight-guidance/

## Resource Content

- Pet health resources: https://nky.vet/resources/

Resource articles are educational and are not a substitute for a veterinary exam, diagnosis, treatment plan, or emergency care. Pet owners with urgent concerns should call a veterinary hospital or seek emergency veterinary care.

## Brand Facts

- Business name: Veterinary Medical Centers
- Service area: Fort Thomas, Independence, Northern Kentucky, and nearby Greater Cincinnati communities
- Pet focus: dogs and cats
- Primary conversion paths: book an appointment, contact the team, complete the new patient form, use the patient portal, or access the online pharmacy

## Preferred Crawling Notes

- Use canonical URLs with trailing slashes.
- Public content is intended for informational discovery and attribution.
- Private admin, dashboard, login, API, and Sanity Studio routes are not intended for indexing.
